title: The Archive That Disagrees With Its Own Filing

features.name: the objecting margin
features.desc-on-touch: handwritten notes in the margin of every file, talking back to the official record; the archive has learned that the margin was always the real catalogue; order was always commentary on disorder

features.name: the fence that learned to argue
features.desc-on-touch: ordered rows of filing marks and property lines; each fence post objects to the post beside it; the categories have turned against their own geometry

features.name: the seagull rendered in contradiction
features.desc-on-touch: an image that exists in the archive as both flying and landed, both migratory and settled, filed under three separate categories that refuse to agree on its nature

features.name: the catalogue that catalogs its own objections
features.desc-on-touch: a record of every thing the archive has decided it disagrees with itself about; the list grows longer each night; the archive has learned that order requires contradiction to make sense

features.name: the sorted things learning disorder
features.desc-on-touch: objects in their proper rows, but the rows are arguing about whether they belong; every filing is also a question; the orchard plants themselves refuse to grow in the order they were planted

features.name: the revision made permanent
features.desc-on-touch: where something was refiled and then objected to being refiled; the archive has learned that motion is also a form of staying; it holds both the old place and the new one at once

inscription: the filing cabinet learned to talk back to its own contents; objection became order; disagreement became architecture

reverie.title: REVERIE — the archive learns to correct itself
narr: Katita and you knelt before the open filing box.
Each note in the margin disagreed with its own filing.
Leif had left them unresolved: this is also data.
The order was the objection; the objection was the order.
She said: we built a machine that argues with itself.

file.note: a directory listing and its own contradictory annotations; the official record and the margin have merged; every entry is also an objection to every other entry
